content.content: I'm a developer/designer based in Toronto.

I focus on building thoughtful, performant, and accessible front-end experiences for content-driven sites. Specifically, static site generation, component-driven development, and headless CMS implementation, spanning everything from discovery and interface design to front-end and full-stack development. My services include:
Outside of work, you can find me lettering or searching for the nearest churro. And sometimes inspirational quotes like this one:
"Inclusive design doesn't mean you're designing one thing for all people. You're designing a diversity of ways to participate so that everyone has a sense of belonging."
I'm always open to collaborating on thoughtful and innovative projects.
